name: privanet-admin
description: Conversational administration for a private PrivaNet deployment with a sandboxed command shell, scoped interactive authorization, diagnostics, and audited privileged operations.

interface.longDescription: Conversational PrivaNet administration with an unprivileged command sandbox, capability-based temporary elevation, explicit fullscreen approval retry controls, per-command TOTP-gated root execution, audited maintenance, node diagnostics, PrivaSearch health, and zero-prompt verified update paths.
defaultPrompt: Check my PrivaNet deployment and summarize anything that needs attention.
Diagnose my nodes and show version drift without making changes.
Run read-only server diagnostics in the sandboxed shell.
Check for verified updates and apply them when I ask.
